target.title: fix(gateway): defer hot-reload restart when dist/entry.js is missing
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Pushing commits into a live production git checkout triggers the gateway's hot-reload while `dist/` is mid-rebuild. The watcher (`requestRestart()` in `scripts/watch-node.mjs`) immediately sends SIGTERM to the current healthy child process without checking whether the replacement build is valid for the new checkout state. The new child cannot start → crash-loop until systemd's start-limit is exhausted (37-min outage, P1, issue #99603).

## Changes

Two guard points using `isBuildReadyForRestart(cwd, fs, resolveHead)` in `scripts/watch-node.mjs`:

### Guard 1 — requestRestart()

Before sending SIGTERM, verify:
1. `dist/entry.js` exists
2. `dist/.buildstamp` git HEAD matches current checkout HEAD

If either check fails (mid-rebuild or stale build), skip the kill and log. The running process is already loaded in memory and continues serving traffic. Restart will trigger on the next relevant file change.

### Guard 2 — Exit handler

When a child exits with SIGTERM/143, verify build readiness before restarting. If the build is not ready (rebuild was interrupted), settle the watcher so systemd restarts the process tree cleanly rather than crash-looping.

### Scope

Partial mitigation — prevents the crash-loop but keeps the existing stop-then-start restart ordering. Issue #99603 should remain open for a transactional restart (build-then-swap). Competing PR #99610 targets the same root cause; maintainers should choose one canonical repair.

## Evidence

### Real behavior proof

Command: `npx tsx proof/hot-reload-race-guard.proof.ts`

```
HOT-RELOAD RACE GUARD PROOF
 Hostname: LIN-66D8BD4EA2C
 PID:      <pid>
 Timestamp: 2026-07-03 18:49:10

 ─── 1. Production code: isBuildReadyForRestart ───
   ✅ Imported from scripts/watch-node.mjs

 ─── 2. Pure function: entry.js + build stamp checks ───
   ✅ entry.js missing → false
   ✅ entry exists, no readFileSync → true (fallback)
   ✅ build stamp HEAD != git HEAD → false
   ✅ build stamp HEAD == git HEAD → true

 ─── 3. Real filesystem lifecycle ───
   ✅ empty dist/ → false
   ✅ entry.js exists, no stamp → false
   ✅ stamp HEAD matches git HEAD → true
   ✅ stamp HEAD != git HEAD → false (git push)
   ✅ re-synced stamp → true (rebuild complete)

 ─── 4. Source code verification ───
   ✅ requestRestart() uses isBuildReadyForRestart
   ✅ Exit handler uses isBuildReadyForRestart
   ✅ isBuildReadyForRestart is exported
   ✅ no polling (narrow fix)

 ─── 5-7. Tests + lint ───
   ✅ Tests 24 passed (including guard tests)
   ✅ All run-node + watch-node tests pass (no regression)
   ✅ Lint: 0 warnings, 0 errors

 RESULTS: 16 passed, 0 failed
```

### Unit tests (24/24 passed)

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/infra/watch-node.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  24 passed (24)
```

### Lint + TypeScript

```
$ npx oxlint --deny-warnings scripts/watch-node.mjs src/infra/watch-node.test.ts
Found 0 warnings and 0 errors.

$ pnpm check:test-types
# no type errors in changed files
```

## Review

- Manually reviewed and verified
- AI-assisted: Yes
- Partial mitigation; issue #99603 should remain open for stronger fix
